ChoiceAnswer.description:
A selected label and its probabilities.

See the [choice primitive](https://docs.typesafe.ai/go/choice) for details.

choice.description: The name of the choice with the highest probability among the question's criteria.
choice.title: Choice

confidence.description: Confidence in the selected choice, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain selections for review.
confidence.title: Confidence

probabilities.description: Probability of each choice in criteria, keyed by choice name, from 0 to 1. Shows how likely the alternatives are; values sum to approximately 1.
probabilities.title: Probabilities

NoulAnswer.description:
A yes/no answer.

See the [noul primitive](https://docs.typesafe.ai/go/noul) for details.

noul.description: Probability of a yes answer or a true statement, from 0 to 1. Values near 1 favor yes or true, values near 0 favor no or false, and values near 0.5 indicate uncertainty.
noul.title: Noul

NoulAnswer.title: NoulAnswer

ScoreAnswer.description:
An expected score with its rubric and probabilities.

score.description: Expected score: the probability-weighted average of the rubric levels. May fall between integer levels.
score.title: Score

confidence.description: Confidence in the score, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain ratings for review.
confidence.title: Confidence
